passives.desc: Monsters fighting each other within 10m of you deal 25% more damage to each other. Weakness: every fight is loud: monsters within 12m come to see it.

active.name: Provoke
active.desc: Mark the monster you look at (within 20m): the nearest other monster within 15m of it attacks it for 8s. Bosses can be attacked, but never attack.

nodes.name: Escalation
nodes.desc: Each hit in a fight deals 5% more than the one before (up to 3 stacks)

nodes.name: Hothead
nodes.desc: 1 more Bad Blood fight can run at once

nodes.name: Feud
nodes.desc: CAPSTONE: bosses can attack too, in Provoke and Bad Blood

nodes.name: Crowd Finder
nodes.desc: Provoke finds an attacker 3m farther away

nodes.name: Free Shot
nodes.desc: If the marked monster dies in the fight, 15% of Provoke's cooldown comes back

branches.name: Ringmaster
branches.desc: Run the show from a safe distance.

nodes.name: Muffled Brawl
nodes.desc: Fights are 8% quieter (monsters come from less far)

nodes.name: Afterglow
nodes.desc: After a fight, both monsters can't see players for 1s

nodes.name: Prize Money
nodes.desc: +2 Scrap for the team per monster killed in a fight

nodes.name: Walk Away
nodes.desc: +5% walk and sprint speed while a fight is within 15m of you

nodes.name: Stampede
nodes.desc: CAPSTONE: a fight ends with both monsters stunned for 2s

classes.name: Ventriloquist
classes.complexityTip: Throw Echo away from your team's path
classes.desc: Talk, and the monsters go the other way. Throw your voice and leave echoes for them to chase.

passives.name: Thrown Voice
passives.desc: When you talk, monsters hear it from up to 10m in front of you instead of from you (teammates still hear you normally). No mic? Hold the Hum key to throw a mumble.

passives.name: Stage Fright
passives.desc: Weakness: everything else you do is 20% louder to monsters (footsteps, things you carry).

active.name: Echo
active.desc: Leaves an echo beacon where you look (up to 14m) that mumbles for 6s: monsters within 14m of it go to investigate it.

nodes.name: Mumble
nodes.desc: The Hum key's mumble pulls monsters from 15% farther

nodes.name: Far Voice
nodes.desc: CAPSTONE: thrown voice +6m farther, mumble 30% stronger

nodes.name: Feedback
nodes.desc: Monsters that reach the echo flinch for 0.5s

nodes.name: Stunning Note
nodes.desc: CAPSTONE: monsters that reach the echo flinch 1.5s longer, and Echo holds 2 charges

nodes.name: Double Echo
nodes.desc: CAPSTONE: Echo leaves a second echo 6m to the side of the first

classes.name: Restorer
classes.complexityTip: Mend near the cart after a rough carry
classes.desc: Nothing stays broken. Damaged valuables slowly win back their value in your hands, and Mend fixes everything nearby.

passives.name: Steady Hands
passives.desc: A valuable you hold wins back 5% of the value it has lost every 2s, up to half of what it lost.

passives.name: Gentle Touch
passives.desc: Weakness: carrying drains 20% more stamina.

active.name: Mend
active.desc: Every valuable within 6m wins back 25% of the value it has lost (up to 75% of what it lost, 25% more than Steady Hands can; once per item per level).

nodes.name: Cart Care
nodes.desc: Steady Hands also works on valuables in a cart within 3m of you

nodes.name: Workshop
nodes.desc: CAPSTONE: valuables teammates within 6m of you hold also win back value (Steady Hands)

nodes.name: Master Mender
nodes.desc: CAPSTONE: Mend restores 30% more and holds 2 charges

nodes.name: Padding
nodes.desc: Valuables you hold lose 2% less value

nodes.name: Stamina
nodes.desc: Offsets Gentle Touch: carrying drains 3.33% less stamina

nodes.name: Padding II
nodes.desc: Valuables you hold lose 2% less value

nodes.name: Steady
nodes.desc: Offsets Gentle Touch: carrying drains 3.33% less stamina

nodes.name: Museum Grade
nodes.desc: CAPSTONE: valuables you hold lose 10% less value

classes.name: Scavenger
classes.complexityTip: Rummage in quiet rooms, never with a monster close
classes.desc: Leaves no drawer unopened. Finds small valuables in rooms nobody has searched, and turns junk gear into more Scrap.

passives.name: Keen Eye
passives.desc: The first time you open a door, locker or cabinet in a room nobody has entered yet, 12% chance to turn up a small valuable. Weakness: what you find is worth half and breaks easily.

passives.name: Scrounger
passives.desc: +10% Scrap when you salvage gear.

active.name: Rummage
active.desc: Search the room you're in for 4s, standing still: turns up 1-3 small valuables. Each room can be rummaged once per level.

nodes.name: Treasure Sense
nodes.desc: CAPSTONE: Keen Eye +8% chance, +2 finds per level

nodes.name: Ransack
nodes.desc: CAPSTONE: Rummage finds 40% more and holds 2 charges

nodes.name: Eye for Value
nodes.desc: Finds are worth 5% more (of their full value)

nodes.name: Antique Dealer
nodes.desc: CAPSTONE: finds are worth 10% more and break 30% less easily

classes.name: Insurer
classes.complexityTip: Tag before long, risky carries
classes.desc: Every loss is somebody's payout. Damage near you turns into Scrap, and a Policy makes sure a lost valuable still counts.

passives.name: Coverage
passives.desc: When a valuable within 8m of you loses value, 10% of what it lost comes back as Scrap, split equally between the team.

passives.name: Claims Adjuster
passives.desc: Valuables you hold lose 10% less value. Weakness: Policy-tagged valuables glow and monsters keep noticing them.

active.name: Policy
active.desc: Tag up to 2 valuables within 4m. If a tagged valuable is destroyed by a monster, hazard or fall after being moved at least 20m since you tagged it, its full value still counts toward the haul.

nodes.name: Full Coverage
nodes.desc: CAPSTONE: Coverage pays 5% more and reaches 4m farther

nodes.name: Umbrella Policy
nodes.desc: CAPSTONE: Policy tags 1 more valuable and holds 2 charges

nodes.name: Dim Tags
nodes.desc: Tagged valuables draw monsters from 10% less far

nodes.name: Careful
nodes.desc: Valuables you hold lose 2% less value

nodes.name: Dim Tags II
nodes.desc: Tagged valuables draw monsters from 10% less far

nodes.name: Careful II
nodes.desc: Valuables you hold lose 2% less value

nodes.name: Discreet
nodes.desc: CAPSTONE: tagged valuables draw monsters from 30% less far

classes.name: Lookout
classes.complexityTip: Cover the routes monsters roam, not dead ends
classes.desc: Sees them first. Teammates near you know what every monster is, and your Watchposts call out anything that walks past.

passives.name: Spotter
passives.desc: Teammates within 12m of you (and you) see the name and threat level of monsters within 25m.

passives.name: Exposed
passives.desc: Weakness: always looking up, never down: you take 10% more damage.

active.name: Watchpost
active.desc: Plants a sensor on the wall you look at (within 4m). For 60s it alerts the team whenever a monster passes within 6m. Up to 2 at once.

nodes.name: Hawkeye
nodes.desc: CAPSTONE: Spotter range +11m and shares 8m farther

nodes.name: Tripwire Flash
nodes.desc: CAPSTONE: each Watchpost flashes and stuns the first monster that passes it for 2s

nodes.name: Sentry Network
nodes.desc: CAPSTONE: Watchpost holds 2 charges, sensors last 30% longer

classes.name: Gunsmith
classes.complexityTip: Overclock when the target is already in your sights
classes.desc: Keeps the shop's guns firing. Guns cost less battery, recharge from your cart, and Overclock turns them up.

passives.name: Efficient Rounds
passives.desc: Guns and launchers you hold use 30% less battery per shot.

passives.name: Field Charger
passives.desc: Hold a gun within 4m of a cart with a battery in it (a drone, flashlight or modded battery) and hold Interact (E) to recharge the gun from it. The battery is drained by what the gun gains. Weakness: -10% max health.

active.name: Overclock
active.desc: For 10s, the gun you hold fires 40% faster, hits 25% harder (not explosions) and uses no battery.

nodes.name: Perpetual
nodes.desc: CAPSTONE: guns use 10% less battery, Field Charger twice as fast

nodes.name: Redline
nodes.desc: CAPSTONE: Overclock 25% stronger and holds 2 charges

nodes.name: Marksman
nodes.desc: CAPSTONE: guns kick 25% less and reach 10% farther

classes.name: Shepherd
classes.complexityTip: Call out pacified monsters so nobody hits them
classes.desc: Nobody needs to get hurt. Monsters are slow to turn on the team around you, and Pacify talks one down completely.

passives.name: Calm Presence
passives.desc: Monsters take 1.5s longer to notice teammates within 8m of you (and you).

passives.name: Pacifist
passives.desc: Weakness: -25% weapon damage.

active.name: Pacify
active.desc: The monster you look at (within 15m) ignores the whole team for 8s, unless someone hits it.

nodes.name: Flock
nodes.desc: CAPSTONE: Pacify also calms every monster within 6m of the one you look at

nodes.name: Drowsy
nodes.desc: Pacified monsters move 6% slower for 5s after it ends

nodes.name: Good Shepherd
nodes.desc: CAPSTONE: Pacify holds 2 charges, pacified monsters 20% slower afterward

classes.name: Grappler
classes.complexityTip: Plan your line before you jump
classes.desc: Gets to anything. A grab that reaches twice as far for small items, and a hook for ledges, walls, ceilings and loot out of reach.

passives.name: Long Reach
passives.desc: Your grab reaches 100% farther for small items (up to 4 kg).

passives.name: Light Frame
passives.desc: Weakness: -15% max health.

active.name: Hook
active.desc: Fire a line at what you look at (up to 18m). A ledge: you climb onto it. A floor or platform: you land there. A wall or ceiling: you cling briefly (Jump pushes off, Crouch drops, Hook again chains). A small item: it's yanked to you, and it can't break on the way. Never through walls or doors.

nodes.name: Heavier Loads
nodes.desc: Long Reach and Hook take items 1 kg heavier

nodes.name: Heavier Loads II
nodes.desc: Long Reach and Hook take items 1 kg heavier

nodes.name: Gecko
nodes.desc: CAPSTONE: Long Reach +30%, items 3 kg heavier

nodes.name: Winch
nodes.desc: Hook pulls 10% harder and faster, to walls and ceilings too

nodes.name: Double Line
nodes.desc: CAPSTONE: Hook holds 2 charges, pulls 20% harder and chains 1 more hook before touching ground

nodes.name: Soft Catch II
nodes.desc: Yanked items are protected 0.5s longer, and you cling 0.4s longer

nodes.name: Harness
nodes.desc: CAPSTONE: +3% max health, yanked items protected 1s longer, clinging drains 50% less stamina

classes.name: Courier
classes.complexityTip: Dispatch when nobody needs to move the item
classes.desc: Skips the walk. Sends small loot straight to the open extraction, and banks what's left on a pad in the truck.

passives.name: Drop Pad
passives.desc: A pad on the truck floor, lit in your colour, that only you can use. Tiny, small and medium valuables you set on it (up to 3) count toward the open extraction's haul goal and are delivered with its haul.

passives.name: Sure-Footed
passives.desc: While you sprint holding a small or medium valuable, light bumps don't damage it and hard ones do 30% less. Weakness: a dispatched item hums (monsters within 10m come to look), and big, wide or tall items can't be dispatched.

active.name: Dispatch
active.desc: Tag a tiny, small or medium valuable within 4m. If nobody moves, grabs or damages it for 10s, it teleports onto the open extraction and counts toward its goal. A cancelled dispatch gives half the cooldown back.

nodes.name: Return Label
nodes.desc: A cancelled dispatch gives 10% more of its cooldown back

nodes.name: Same-Day
nodes.desc: CAPSTONE: Dispatch holds 2 charges, and two items can count down at once

branches.name: Freight Rules
branches.desc: More on the pad, more kinds of parcel.

nodes.name: Bigger Pad
nodes.desc: The Drop Pad holds 1 more item

nodes.name: Pad Bonus
nodes.desc: Items delivered from the Drop Pad are worth 4% more

nodes.name: Fragile Sticker
nodes.desc: A tagged item can lose up to 5% of its value before the dispatch cancels

nodes.name: On the Route
nodes.desc: +6% walk and sprint speed for 6s after one of your dispatches lands

nodes.name: Oversize Permit
nodes.desc: CAPSTONE: big items can be dispatched too (5s longer countdown); wide and tall still can't

nodes.name: Muffled Box
nodes.desc: Tagged items hum 10% quieter (monsters come from less far)

nodes.name: Signed For
nodes.desc: A tagged item can be nudged 0.3m more before the dispatch cancels

nodes.name: Rush Fee
nodes.desc: Each of your dispatches that lands gives every teammate 1 Scrap

nodes.name: Dead Drop
nodes.desc: CAPSTONE: with no open extraction, Dispatch sends the item to your Drop Pad instead (if it has room)
